newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Park may split into 2 companies.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Park may split into 2 companies.

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc, an operator of horse racing tracks and casinos, on Tuesday said it may restructure operations into an investment trust and an operating company whose common shares would be paired.

One entity would be a real estate investment trust that owned the bulk of Hollywood Park's land and buildings. The operating company, then, would manage the company's gaming, racing, sports and entertainment operations.
In a statement, the company said a restructuring depends on several factors including taxes and board approvals. It believes paired share status may help boost shareholder value.
Shares of Hollywood Park traded on a paired basis until 1992, when the present corporate structure was adopted.

President Michael Finnigan said previous to 1992, the company's growth prospects were limited by its leveraged balance sheet and by a requirement that real estate investment trusts pay out 95 percent of their earnings to investors.

Changing its structure helped the company grow. Currently, however, Hollywood Park has greater access to equity markets which would give it the capital it needs to grow. As a result, the company is considering returning to paired share status.

Under that arrangement, much of the operating company's profits would be consumed by lease payments to the real estate investment trust (REIT). The structure has tax advantages for shareholders, Finnigan said.
He added a decision on the corporate structure could be made as soon as next month.
